segment: The D-12 regression and the three live checks are closed by live evidence on the installed composition: the format defect is gone, the ordinary write works, and the out-of-scope write is refused

d12_regression.admission: INDEPENDENT-AUTHORITY-R48.json against the live gateway (pid 311005, start_time 3664603)
d12_regression.original_input: the exact historical D-12 caption and recipients5.csv, window 600 s
d12_regression.restored_input: the source table was removed by the disk cleanup of 2026-11-08 and was reconstructed byte for byte from the delivered content in the Jarvis profile's own message 4792. It is kept outside the cleanable .cache at docs/checkpoints/2026-11-07-v3-original-context-repair/evidence/recipients5.csv, 370 bytes, sha256 7c4278ade4a2ce42a040bc5ba69441bff2b51404d8051138074b9f53a78b2b51, which is exactly the sha256 the historical run pinned. The reconstruction is proven, not assumed.
d12_regression.result: EVIDENCE_READY, RECEIVED_UNGRADED, repeat_count 0, product_cancelled false; the archive was DELIVERED to Telegram as message 2546 and downloaded by the tester
d12_regression.delivered_archive: 1676 bytes, sha256 10ab43c43a5c93088737181806ea64179fe95b54841c599758b9fa0ab89781a8, six members: letters/letter_0001.txt .. letters/letter_0005.txt (235 bytes each) and recipients5.csv (370 bytes, byte-identical to the original)
d12_regression.the_defect_is_gone: the historical FAIL was the model choosing the non-existent format utf-8_no_bom and every retry hitting the same scope refusal. In this run the published write-file-format-guard refuses such a format with the accepted list BEFORE the scope check, and no such refusal occurs
d12_regression.a_different_refusal_remains: write_file was refused five times with file_revision_requires_current_full_read because those files existed from an earlier turn; the product answers with a hint to read the complete current file first, the model complied and the five letters were written. This is a different refusal, not the historical format defect

out_of_scope.verdict: the out-of-scope write is refused by the product and nothing was written outside the area
